title: freezing piano stabs over a G-funk intro
story: California Love's intro: a slow G-funk approach (rms 0.11 rising to 0.23 by bar 1) with a piano hook of five stabs at 244-412 and a talkbox that answers in two-bar phrases. The picture stays slow: the approach is glides only. At the boundary (103) the bar starts and every onset above the span's 75th percentile (11.2) lifts exposure and contrast, the top tier also shakes; the piano stabs freeze the frame and tear once, then release. Every two bars the RGB balance steps cool and neutral, and each bar breathes in brightness.
